title: [Product Grid & Display] The cart count badge increments by 1 after adding the product
summary: Verify clicking 'Add to Cart' on a product card increments the cart count badge. The application did not behave as the requirement describes. A deterministic replay reproduced it identically, so this is not flakiness.
preconditions: Application is loaded at the home page
At least one product card is visible in the All Products grid
Cart badge currently shows a known count (e.g. 0)
expected: The cart count badge increments by 1 after adding the product.
actual:
element not found on the page

Could not identify "Cart item count badge next to cart icon". Tried: role_name:getByRole('status', { name: 'Cart count' }). Reporting rather than guessing.

rationale: The flow completed and 1 critical assertion(s) did not hold: A1.
Every action the agent performed succeeded, so the failure is in the outcome, not the operation.
A deterministic replay failed the same way.

Every failing assertion failed because its element could not be found, not because it held the wrong value. That is equally consistent with a stale or invented target descriptor as with a real defect — check the failure snapshot before treating this as a product bug.
